data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Ron', meaning 'strong' or 'powerful'. The name Ronni carries the meaning “Little strong one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ronni usually hope their child will grow to embody little strong one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
